item.text: {"action":"write","arguments_json":"{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate state-transition requests against a policy.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate a request without modifying either input.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    source = request.get(\\\"from\\\")\\n    target = request.get(\\\"to\\\")\\n    edge = policy.get(\\\"edges\\\", {}).get(f\\\"{source}>{target}\\\")\\n\\n    if edge is None:\\n        return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"blocked\\\"}\\n\\n    required_role = edge.get(\\\"role\\\")\\n    if required_role is not None and request.get(\\\"role\\\") != required_role:\\n        return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"permission\\\"}\\n\\n    if request.get(\\\"retry\\\"):\\n        attempts = request.get(\\\"attempts\\\")\\n        retry_limit = policy.get(\\\"retry_limit\\\")\\n        if (\\n            type(attempts) is not int\\n            or type(retry_limit) is not int\\n            or not 0 <= attempts < retry_limit\\n        ):\\n            return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"retry_limit\\\"}\\n\\n    return {\\\"ok\\\": True, \\\"value\\\": target, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"ok\\\"}\\n\"}"}
